long_biography.plain_text:
An early turning point in Brett Palos's career was the acquisition of ISA, an office-supplies group. Its subsequent sale supplied the capital that independent business reporting identified as the foundation of his fortune. Palos also served on the board of Arcadia Group, the retail business associated with his stepfather. That role gave his separately built investment career a substantial family-business platform rather than an independent start.

Palos shifted that capital toward property and private investment. Brett Palos Investments became the vehicle for corporate, commercial and residential acquisitions, including large London transactions. He and Antony Alberti later acquired and reshaped Thackeray Estates; the current group lists Palos as chairman and co-founder. In Miami, his wholly owned Palos Developments has built ultra-prime homes. Those portfolios and transaction values belong to the relevant companies and joint ventures, not automatically to Palos personally.
